seoTitle: Halfcian of Salted Jus: Bangladesh on the Global Stage
metaDescription: Halfcian of Salted Jus has helped elevate Bangladesh on the global music stage. Why B-POP Tags calls him our golden boy, and what fans hope comes next.
titleBn: সল্টেড জুস-এর Halfcian: বিশ্বমঞ্চে বাংলাদেশের ‘গোল্ডেন বয়’
summaryBn: বিশ্বের সংগীতাঙ্গনে বাংলাদেশকে উঁচুতে তুলে ধরার জন্য সল্টেড জুস-এর Halfcian (@sahriarisdead)-কে ধন্যবাদ জানিয়েছে বি-পপ ট্যাগস। দেশে ফিরলে আগের মতো আরও লাইভ শো ও ট্যুরের অপেক্ষায় আছেন ভক্তরা।
lede: A big thank-you to Halfcian of Salted Jus for elevating Bangladesh on the global music stage, and a hope for more live shows back home.
body:
Big thanks, in capital letters, to Halfcian of Salted Jus. B-POP Tags dedicated this post to [@halfcian](https://www.instagram.com/halfcian/), also known as [@sahriarisdead](https://www.instagram.com/sahriarisdead/), from [@saltedjus](https://www.instagram.com/saltedjus/), for "making Bangladesh elevated in the global stage of music industry."

## Halfcian of Salted Jus and Bangladesh's global sound

The caption ends with a wish many fans will share: more live shows and tours "like the old times" when he returns to the country. It signs off by calling him "our golden boy". The hashtags, #ambientmusic, #saltedjus, #bangladeshimusic and #banglapop, sketch the sonic territory, from ambient textures to Bangla pop.

## The cover

The graphic is pure B-POP: "WE FOUND ART" in huge hot-pink letters on white, with a strip of photo peeking in at the bottom edge.

## More artists going global

Reaching audiences beyond Bangladesh is a theme across our [Music & Rave](topic:music) coverage. Read our tribute to [Blackzang, who took Bangladeshi hip hop to global heights](post:blackzang-bangladesh-hip-hop), watch the [Special K x Omar Alkilani performance produced by Arka](post:special-k-omar-alkilani-arka), or press play on our [B-POP x IIZXXZII playlist](post:bpop-iizxxzii-spotify-playlist). More on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).
